title: ZIP64 uses extra fields to carry overflow size or offset
summary: When a traditional field takes an upper limit mark such as 0xffffffff, the large value must be interpreted from the corresponding ZIP64 extended structure.
detail: 0x0001 Extra fields give the values in the original record that need to be extended in the specified order; not every file lists all possible fields.
boundary: Reading the member size of ZIP64 and reading the total number of members for the entire archive involve different records.
relevance: Avoid interpreting extension field placeholder values as actual four-GiB members.
